description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulic Machines topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: fluid-mechanics

facts.claim: Viscosity is a fluid's resistance to relative motion (shear)

source.quote: viscosity is a property of a fluid that quantifies the resistance force acting on fluids when there is relative motion between fluid parcels

facts.claim: Newtonian fluid: shear stress ∝ strain rate

source.quote: directly proportional to the strain rate

facts.claim: Buoyant force equals the weight of fluid displaced (Archimedes)

source.quote: is equivalent to the weight of the fluid that would otherwise occupy the submerge
The pressure of a fluid increases with depth below the fluid's surface because of the weight of the fluid above

facts.claim: Streamlines are tangent to the velocity everywhere

source.quote: Streamlines are a family of curves whose tangent vectors constitute the velocity vector field of the flow
Since mass, energy, momentum, electric charge and other natural quantities are conserved

facts.claim: Higher speed goes with lower pressure

source.quote: an increase in the speed occurs simultaneously with a decrease in pressure

facts.claim: In a constriction velocity rises and pressure falls (used to measure flow)

source.quote: As the fluid flows into a smaller area, the fluid's velocity increases, while the static pressure decreases

facts.claim: Physical laws can be written with dimensionless π groups (n − k groups)

source.quote: any physical law can be expressed as an identity involving only dimensionless combinations

facts.claim: Hagen–Poiseuille gives the pressure drop of laminar pipe flow
Assumes incompressible Newtonian fluid in laminar flow

source.quote: the flow is laminar through a pipe of constant circular cross-section
measuring the ratio between inertial and viscous forces

facts.claim: Low Re → laminar; high Re → turbulent

source.quote: At low Reynolds numbers, flows tend to be dominated by laminar (sheet-like) flow, while at high Reynolds numbers, flows tend to be turbulent

facts.claim: Darcy–Weisbach: head loss from a friction factor, length, diameter and velocity

source.quote: the Darcy–Weisbach equation is an empirical equation that relates the head loss, or pressure loss

facts.claim: Friction factor from the Moody chart

source.quote: combined with the Moody chart for calculating head losses in pipes

facts.claim: The impeller converts rotational kinetic energy into fluid energy

source.quote: by the conversion of rotational kinetic energy to the hydrodynamic energy of the fluid flow

facts.claim: Pelton wheel is an impulse turbine with jets on buckets

source.quote: The Pelton wheel or Pelton Turbine is an impulse-type water turbine

facts.claim: Best when bucket speed is about half the jet speed

source.quote: when the rim ran at half the speed of the water jet
